capabilities: Draws progress bars from note properties
Moves position with buttons, commands and hotkeys
Sums tagged notes against a page goal with deadline
Keeps a dated reading log and estimates pace
Generates a Bases file with five book views
disambiguation: Not just for books: any note with a total and a current number can be tracked, with configurable property names, tag and labels.
extras: Needs Obsidian 1.10 or later; works without Dataview, Meta Bind or any other community plugin, and all data stays in plain note properties. Mobile layout checked only in Obsidian's mobile emulation, not on a device.
problem: Obsidian keeps page numbers as bare properties, with no bar, controls or vault-wide total to show progress through a book or toward a reading goal.

relations.evidence: Progress bars needs the plugin and the Bases core plugin turned on.

summary: Property-driven progress tracker that draws bars for books or any total/current pair, moves them with buttons and hotkeys, and sums pages against a goal.
